description_en: Creates a listener for an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 创建监听全球加速实例
kebab_example: aliyun ga create-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --port-ranges FromPort=20 ToPort=20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateListener

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA)
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the listener.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
监听的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the listener.

The description can be up to 200 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
监听的描述信息。

描述长度最大为200个字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The client affinity.

If you do not set this parameter, client affinity is not maintained. This means that connection requests from the same client may not always be routed to the same endpoint.

If you set the value to SOURCE_IP, client affinity is maintained. When a client accesses a stateful application, all requests from the same client are routed to the same endpoint, regardless of the source port and protocol
parameters.help_zh:
客户端亲和性。

不传入值时，不保持客户端亲和性，即不能确保来自同一客户端的连接请求始终定向到同一终端节点。

取值为SOURCE_IP时，保持客户端亲和性。即客户端访问有状态的应用程序时，可以将来自同一客户端的所有请求都定向到同一终端节点，而不考虑源端口和协议
parameters.name: client_affinity

parameters.help_en:
The network transmission protocol type of the listener. Valid values:

tcp: TCP.

udp: UDP.

http: HTTP.

https: HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
监听的网络传输协议类型，取值：

tcp：TCP协议。

udp：UDP协议。

http：HTTP协议。

https：HTTPS协议
parameters.name: protocol

fields.help_en:
The start listener port that is used to accept and forward requests to endpoints.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort.

The maximum number of ports that you can configure depends on the listener routing type and protocol type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html.
For HTTP or HTTPS listeners, you can configure only one listener port. This means that the start port and the end port must be the same
fields.help_zh:
用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的起始监听端口。

可配置的监听端口范围为1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort。

最多可配置端口数量与监听路由类型和监听协议类型相关，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html。
对于HTTP或HTTPS协议的监听，只支持配置一个监听端口，即起始监听端口和结束监听端口需相同
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The end listener port that is used to accept and forward requests to endpoints.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort.

The maximum number of ports that you can configure depends on the listener routing type and protocol type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html.

For HTTP or HTTPS listeners, you can configure only one listener port. This means that the start port and the end port must be the same
fields.help_zh:
用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的结束监听端口。

可配置的监听端口范围为1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort。

最多可配置端口数量与监听路由类型和监听协议类型相关，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html。

对于HTTP或HTTPS协议的监听，只支持配置一个监听端口，即起始监听端口和结束监听端口需相同
fields.name: to_port

parameters.help_en:
The listener port information.
Valid values for the listener port: 1 to 65499.
The maximum number of ports that you can configure depends on the listener routing type and protocol type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html
parameters.help_zh:
监听端口信息。
可配置的监听端口范围为1~65499。
最多可配置端口数量与监听路由类型和监听协议类型相关，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html
parameters.name: port_ranges

fields.help_en:

This parameter is required only for HTTPS listeners

SSL证书ID。

仅HTTPS协议的监听需要配置该参数

Specifies whether to use the GA-AP header field to retrieve the acceleration area information. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no.

This parameter is supported only by HTTP and HTTPS listeners

true：是。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

Specifies whether to use the GA-ID header field to retrieve the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance ID. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no.

This parameter is supported only by HTTP and HTTPS listeners

是否通过`GA-ID`头字段获取全球加速实例ID。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_ga_id_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the GA-X-Forward-Port header field to retrieve the listener port of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no.

This parameter is supported only by HTTP and HTTPS listeners
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Port`字段获取全球加速实例的监听端口。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_port_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the GA-X-Forward-Proto header field to retrieve the listener protocol of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no.

This parameter is supported only by HTTP and HTTPS listeners
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Proto`字段获取全球加速实例的监听协议。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_proto_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the X-Real-IP header field to retrieve the actual client IP address. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no.

This parameter is supported only by HTTP and HTTPS listeners
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Real-IP`字段获取真实的客户端IP。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

parameters.help_en:
The routing type of the listener. Valid values:

Standard (default): intelligent routing.
CustomRouting: custom route.

The custom route feature for listeners is in invitational preview. To use this feature, contact your Alibaba Cloud account manager.
You cannot configure both routing types for listeners of the same standard Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. After the routing type is configured, it cannot be changed. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html
parameters.help_zh:
监听的路由类型。取值：

Standard（默认值）：智能路由类型。
CustomRouting：自定义路由类型。

监听支持自定义路由类型的功能邀测中，如需使用，请联系阿里云客户经理。
同一个标准型全球加速实例，不支持同时配置两种路由类型的监听，且路由类型配置完成后不支持变更。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153216.html

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP address preservation by using the automatic retrieval method. Valid values:

true: enables client IP address preservation.

false (default): disables client IP address preservation.


By default, client IP address preservation is disabled for endpoint groups associated with UDP or TCP listeners. You can configure this parameter based on your business requirements.
By default, client IP address preservation is enabled for endpoint groups associated with HTTP or HTTPS listeners. The client IP address is retrieved by using the X-Forwarded-For header field. You cannot disable this feature.
EnableClientIPPreservation and EnableProxyProtocol cannot be set to true at the same time.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用自动获取方式开启保持客户端源 IP 功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。


UDP/TCP 监听对应的终端节点组默认不开启保持客户端源IP，您可根据业务需要配置。
HTTP（S）监听对应的终端节点组默认开启保持客户端源IP，通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取。不支持关闭。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_client_ip_preservation

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP address preservation by using the Proxy Protocol method. Valid values:

true: enables client IP address preservation.

false (default): disables client IP address preservation.
This parameter is supported only for endpoint groups associated with TCP listeners.
EnableClientIPPreservation and EnableProxyProtocol cannot be set to true at the same time.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源IP功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。
仅支持TCP监听对应的终端节点组配置。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_proxy_protocol

fields.help_en:
The IP address or domain name of the endpoint for the intelligent routing listener.

You can enter up to 100 IP addresses or domain names of endpoints in an endpoint group of an intelligent routing listener.

This parameter is required when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点的IP或域名。

在智能路由类型监听的某个终端节点组中，您最多可以输入100个终端节点的IP或域名。

当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息，且该参数必填

fields.help_en:
The private IP of the elastic network interface controller (NIC).

This parameter is optional when the endpoint type is ENI. If you do not configure this parameter, the primary private IP of the ENI is used by default
fields.help_zh:
弹性网卡的私网IP地址。

当终端节点类型为ENI时，可以选择配置该参数，如果不配置默认为ENI的主私网IP地址
fields.name: sub_address

fields.help_en:
The endpoint type for the intelligent routing listener. Valid values:
Domain: custom domain name.
Ip: custom IP address.
PublicIp: Alibaba Cloud public IP address.
ECS: Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.
SLB: Alibaba Cloud SLB instance.
ALB: Alibaba Cloud ALB instance.
OSS: Alibaba Cloud OSS instance.
ENI: Alibaba Cloud elastic network interface controller (NIC).
NLB: Alibaba Cloud NLB instance.
IpTarget: custom private IP.

You can enter up to 100 endpoint types in an endpoint group of an intelligent routing listener.
This parameter is required when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing).
If the endpoint type is ECS, ENI, SLB, ALB, NLB, or IpTarget and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint.
If the endpoint type is ALB and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb.
If the endpoint type is OSS and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss.
If the endpoint type is NLB and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点类型。取值：
Domain：自定义域名。
Ip：自定义IP。
PublicIp：阿里云公网IP。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
SLB：阿里云SLB实例。
ALB：阿里云ALB实例。
OSS：阿里云OSS实例。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
NLB：阿里云NLB 实例。
IpTarget：自定义私网IP。

在智能路由类型监听的某个终端节点组中，您最多可以输入100个终端节点类型。
当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息，且该参数必填。
终端节点类型取值为ECS、ENI、SLB、ALB、NLB或IpTarget时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为ALB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为OSS时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为NLB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为 AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb的服务关联角色。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html

fields.help_en:
The weight of the endpoint for the intelligent routing listener.

Valid values: 0 to 255.

You can enter up to 100 endpoint weights in an endpoint group of an intelligent routing listener.

This parameter is required when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing).
If the weight of an endpoint is set to 0, Global Accelerator stops distributing traffic to the endpoint. Proceed with caution
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点权重。

取值范围：0~255。

在智能路由类型监听的某个终端节点组中，您最多可以输入100个终端节点的权重。

当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息，且该参数必填。
如果某个终端节点的权重设置为0，全球加速将终止向该终端节点分发流量，请您谨慎操作

fields.help_en:
The description of the endpoint group for the intelligent routing listener.

The description can be up to 200 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can enter up to 10 endpoint group descriptions.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点组描述信息。

描述长度最大200字符，不能包含`http://`和`https://`字符。

您最多可以输入10个终端节点组描述信息。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息

fields.help_en:
The name of the endpoint group for the intelligent routing listener.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

You can enter up to 10 endpoint group names.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点组名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

您最多可以输入10个终端节点组名称。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: endpoint_group_name

fields.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint group for the intelligent routing listener.

You can enter up to 10 region IDs for the endpoint group.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点组所属地域ID。

您最多可以输入10个终端节点组的地域ID。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: endpoint_group_region

fields.help_en:
The endpoint group type for the intelligent routing listener. Valid values:
default (default): default endpoint group.
virtual: virtual endpoint group.

You can enter up to 10 endpoint group types.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing).
You can create virtual endpoint groups only for HTTP or HTTPS intelligent routing listeners
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点组类型。取值：
default（默认值）：默认终端节点组。
virtual：虚拟终端节点组。

您最多可以输入10个终端节点组类型。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息。
仅HTTP或HTTPS协议的智能路由类型监听才支持创建虚拟终端节点组
fields.name: endpoint_group_type

fields.help_en:
The IP address protocol of the backend service. Valid values:  
IPv4 (default): GA communicates with the endpoint service only by using IPv4 addresses.  
IPv6: GA communicates with the endpoint service only by using IPv6 addresses.  
ProtocolAffinity: The IP protocol used by GA to communicate with the endpoint service is the same as the IP protocol used by the client request
fields.help_zh:
后端IP地址协议。取值：  
IPv4：（默认值）：GA仅使用IPv4地址与终端节点服务通信。  
IPv6：GA仅使用IPv6地址与终端节点服务通信。  
ProtocolAffinity：GA与终端节点服务通信的IP协议与客户端请求使用的IP协议相同
fields.name: endpoint_ip_version

fields.help_en:
Terms of Service protocol version of the endpoint for the intelligent routing listener. Valid values:

HTTP1.1 (default): HTTP/1.1.

HTTP2: HTTP/2.

You can configure Terms of Service protocol version only when the value of EndpointRequestProtocol (backend service protocol) is HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点后端服务协议版本。取值：

HTTP1.1（默认值）：HTTP1.1版本。

HTTP2：HTTP2版本。

仅当EndpointRequestProtocol（终端节点后端服务协议）值为HTTPS时，支持配置终端节点后端服务协议版本
fields.name: endpoint_protocol_version

fields.help_en:
Terms of Service protocol of the endpoint for the intelligent routing listener. Valid values:
HTTP (default): HTTP.
HTTPS: HTTPS.

You can enter up to 10 backend service protocols.
You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing).
This parameter is supported only when you create an endpoint group for an HTTP or HTTPS intelligent routing listener.
For HTTP listeners, Terms of Service protocol supports and only supports HTTP
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点后端服务协议。取值：
HTTP（默认值）：HTTP协议。
HTTPS：HTTPS协议。

您最多可以输入10个后端服务协议。
仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息。
仅为HTTP或HTTPS协议的智能路由类型监听创建终端节点组时才支持配置该项。
对于HTTP协议的监听，后端服务协议支持且仅支持HTTP
fields.name: endpoint_request_protocol

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks for the endpoint group of the intelligent routing listener. Valid values:
true: enables health checks.
false (default): disables health checks.

You can enable health checks for up to 10 endpoint groups.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
是否为智能路由类型监听的终端节点组开启健康检查。取值：
true：开启健康检查。
false（默认值）：关闭健康检查。

您最多可以开启10个终端节点组的健康检查。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: health_check_enabled

fields.help_en: The domain name for health checks
fields.help_zh: 健康检查域名
fields.name: health_check_host

fields.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds.

You can enter up to 10 health check intervals.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔，单位：秒。

您最多可以输入10个健康检查的时间间隔。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: health_check_interval_seconds

fields.help_en: The HTTP request method used for health checks
fields.help_zh: 健康检查使用的HTTP请求方法
fields.name: health_check_method

fields.help_en:
The health check path.

You can enter up to 10 health check paths.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
健康检查路径。

您最多可以输入10个健康检查路径。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: health_check_path

fields.help_en:
The health check port. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

You can enter up to 10 health check ports.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的端口。取值范围：1~65535。

您最多可以输入10个健康检查的端口。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: health_check_port

fields.help_en:
The health check protocol. Valid values:
tcp or TCP: TCP.
http or HTTP: HTTP.
https or HTTPS: HTTPS.

You can enter up to 10 health check protocols.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的协议。取值：
tcp或TCP：TCP协议。
http或HTTP：HTTP协议。
https或HTTPS：HTTPS协议。

您最多可以输入10个健康检查的协议。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: health_check_protocol

fields.help_en: The set of HTTP status codes that indicate a successful health check
fields.help_zh: 健康检查判定为成功的状态码集合
fields.name: health_check_success_codes

fields.help_en:
The endpoint port for port mapping.

You can enter up to 5 endpoint ports for port mapping.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing).
For TCP listeners: Virtual endpoint groups do not support port mapping. If a virtual endpoint group already exists under the listener, the default endpoint group cannot be configured with port mapping. If the default endpoint group is already configured with port mapping, you cannot add a virtual endpoint group.
After port mapping is configured, the following limits apply to subsequent listener modifications: You cannot modify the listener protocol, except for switching between HTTP and HTTPS.
Listener port: The modified listener port range must include all listener ports currently configured for port mapping. For example, if the listener port range is 80-82 and port mapping is configured to endpoint ports 100-102, you cannot change the listener port range to 80-81 later
fields.help_zh:
配置端口映射时的终端节点端口。

您最多可以输入5个端口映射中的终端节点端口。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息。
对于TCP监听：虚拟终端节点组不支持配置端口映射。如果监听下已存在虚拟终端节点组，则默认终端节点组无法配置端口映射。如果默认终端节点组已配置端口映射，则无法添加虚拟终端节点组。
配置端口映射后，后续监听变更时有以下限制：除HTTP和HTTPS之间的协议切换以外，不支持修改监听协议。
监听端口：您修改的监听端口范围必须包含当前所配置端口映射的全量监听端口。例如，当监听端口范围为80-82，并配置端口映射至终端节点端口100-102时，后续修改监听端口范围时，不支持修改为80-81
fields.name: endpoint_port

fields.help_en:
The listener port for port mapping.

You can enter up to 5 listener ports for port mapping.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing).
For TCP listeners: Virtual endpoint groups do not support port mapping. If a virtual endpoint group already exists under the listener, the default endpoint group cannot be configured with port mapping. If the default endpoint group is already configured with port mapping, you cannot add a virtual endpoint group.
After port mapping is configured, the following limits apply to subsequent listener modifications: You cannot modify the listener protocol, except for switching between HTTP and HTTPS.
Listener port: The modified listener port range must include all listener ports currently configured for port mapping. For example, if the listener port range is 80-82 and port mapping is configured to endpoint ports 100-102, you cannot change the listener port range to 80-81 later
fields.help_zh:
配置端口映射时的监听端口。

您最多可以输入5个端口映射中的监听端口。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息。
对于TCP监听：虚拟终端节点组不支持配置端口映射。如果监听下已存在虚拟终端节点组，则默认终端节点组无法配置端口映射。如果默认终端节点组已配置端口映射，则无法添加虚拟终端节点组。
配置端口映射后，后续监听变更时有以下限制：除HTTP和HTTPS之间的协议切换以外，不支持修改监听协议。
监听端口：您修改的监听端口范围必须包含当前所配置端口映射的全量监听端口。例如，当监听端口范围为80-82，并配置端口映射至终端节点端口100-102时，后续修改监听端口范围时，不支持修改为80-81
fields.name: listener_port

fields.help_en: The port mapping relationships
fields.help_zh: 端口映射关系
fields.name: port_overrides

fields.help_en:
The number of consecutive health checks that are required to change the health check status. This refers to the number of consecutive failed health checks required to change the status from healthy to unhealthy, or the number of consecutive successful health checks required to change the status from unhealthy to healthy.
Valid values: 2 to 10. Default value: 3.

You can enter up to 10 threshold counts for health check status changes.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
针对健康检查状态变化所需要的连续健康检查次数，即从成功到失败的连续健康检查失败次数或从失败到成功的连续健康检查成功次数。
取值范围：2~10。默认值：3。

您最多可以输入10个健康检查状态变化所需要的连续健康检查次数值。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: threshold_count

fields.help_en:
The traffic distribution ratio. When an intelligent routing listener has multiple endpoint groups, this parameter specifies the proportion of traffic distributed to different endpoint groups.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100.

You can enter up to 10 traffic distribution ratios for the endpoint groups.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
fields.help_zh:
流量调配值，即智能路由类型监听有多个终端节点组时，配置到不同终端节点组的流量比例。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：100。

您最多可以输入10个终端节点组的流量调配值。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: traffic_percentage

parameters.help_en:
The configuration information of the endpoint group for the intelligent routing listener.

You can configure up to 10 endpoint groups of this type.

You can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for an intelligent routing listener only when the value of Type (listener routing type) is Standard (intelligent routing)
parameters.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点组的配置信息。

您最多可以配置10个该类型终端节点组。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
parameters.name: endpoint_group_configurations

fields.help_en:
The description of the endpoint group for a custom route listener.

The description can be up to 200 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify descriptions for up to five endpoint groups.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组的描述信息。

描述长度最大200字符，不能包含`http://`和`https://`字符。

最多可以输入5个终端节点组的描述信息。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The start port of the backend service in the endpoint group for a custom route listener.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort.

You can specify up to 20 start ports of the backend service for each endpoint group of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组后端服务起始端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点组下，最多可输入20条后端服务起始端口信息。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the backend Terms of Service in the endpoint group for a custom route listener.

You can specify up to four backend Terms of Service protocol types in the port range and protocol mappings for each endpoint group of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组后端服务的协议类型。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点组映射端口范围和协议类型信息中，最多可以输入4个后端服务协议类型。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: protocols

fields.help_en:
The end port of the backend service in the endpoint group for a custom route listener.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort.

You can specify up to 20 end ports of the backend service for each endpoint group of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点组下，最多可输入20条后端服务结束端口信息。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: to_port

fields.help_en:
The mapping configurations of the endpoint group for a custom route listener.

You must specify the service port range and protocol type of the backend service in the endpoint group. The specified information is mapped to the service port range of the associated listener.

You can specify up to 20 port range and protocol mappings for each endpoint group of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组的映射信息配置。

您需要输入终端节点组后端服务端口范围和协议类型，输入信息与关联的监听端口范围将形成映射关系。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点组下，最多可输入20条映射端口范围和协议类型信息。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: destination_configurations

fields.help_en:
The name of the vSwitch instance for the endpoint of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点交换机（vSwitch）实例名称。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en:
The IP address of the destination that can accept access traffic.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify up to 20 destination IP addresses for each endpoint of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标IP地址。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标IP地址。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The start port of the destination that can accept access traffic. The port must fall within the backend service port range of the endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 destinations for each endpoint of a custom route listener. You can specify up to five start ports for each destination.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的起始端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy（流量通行策略）取值为AllowCustom（指定可接受访问流量的通行目标）时，该项生效。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入5个起始端口。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The end port of the destination that can accept access traffic. The port must fall within the backend service port range of the endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 destinations for each endpoint of a custom route listener. You can specify up to five end ports for each destination.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的结束端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy（流量通行策略）取值为AllowCustom（指定可接受访问流量的通行目标）时，该项生效。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入5个结束端口。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: to_port

fields.help_en:
The service port range of the destination that can accept access traffic. The service port range must fall within the service port range of the backend service in the endpoint group.

If this parameter is left empty, all ports of the destination are supported.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 destinations for each endpoint of a custom route listener. You can specify up to five port ranges for each destination.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标端口范围。该端口范围必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy（流量通行策略）取值为AllowCustom（指定可接受访问流量的通行目标）时，该项生效。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入5个端口范围。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: port_ranges

fields.help_en:
The traffic destination configurations for the endpoint of a custom route listener.

You can specify up to 20 traffic destinations for each endpoint of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点流量通行目标配置。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: policy_configurations

fields.help_en:
The traffic access policy for the backend service of the endpoint for a custom route listener. Valid values:
DenyAll (default): denies all access traffic to the specified backend service.
AllowAll: allows all access traffic to the specified backend service.
AllowCustom: specifies the destinations that can accept access traffic.
You must specify the IP address and port range of the destination. If the port range is left empty, all ports of the destination are supported.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点后端服务流量通行策略，取值：
DenyAll（默认值）：拒绝所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。
AllowAll：允许所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。
AllowCustom：指定可以接收访问流量的通行目标。
您需要指定该通信目标的IP地址和端口范围，端口范围输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: traffic_to_endpoint_policy

fields.help_en:
The backend service type of the endpoint for a custom route listener. Valid values:

PrivateSubNet (default): private network CIDR block.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点后端服务类型。取值：

 PrivateSubNet（默认值）：私网CIDR。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The endpoint configurations for a custom route listener.

You can specify up to 10 endpoints for each endpoint group of a custom route listener.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点信息。

自定义路由类型监听的每个终端节点组下，最多可输入10个终端节点信息。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: endpoint_configurations

fields.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint group for a custom route listener.

You can specify up to five region IDs for endpoint groups.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组所属地域ID。

您最多可以输入5个终端节点组地域ID。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: endpoint_group_region

fields.help_en:
The name of the endpoint group for a custom route listener.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

You can specify up to five endpoint group names.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
fields.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

最多可以输入5个终端节点组名称。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint group configurations for a custom route listener.

You can configure up to five endpoint groups of this type.

You can configure endpoint groups and endpoints for a custom route listener only when Type is set to CustomRouting
parameters.help_zh:
自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组配置信息。

您最多可以配置5个该类型终端节点组。

仅当Type（监听路由类型）值为CustomRouting（自定义路由类型）时，支持配置自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息
parameters.name: custom_routing_endpoint_group_configurations

parameters.help_en:
The idle connection timeout period. Unit: seconds.

TCP: 10 to 900. Default value: 900.
UDP: 10 to 20. Default value: 20. 
HTTP/HTTPS: 1 to 60. Default value: 15
parameters.help_zh:
连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒。

TCP：10-900s，默认900s
UDP：10-20s ，默认20s 
HTTP/HTTPS：1-60秒，默认15s
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The request timeout period for HTTP or HTTPS connections. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 180. Default value: 60.

This parameter takes effect only for listeners whose protocol type is HTTP or HTTPS. If the backend server does not return a response within the timeout period, Global Accelerator stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP/HTTPS的连接请求超时时间。单位：秒。

可选：1-180秒，默认60s。

仅对Protocol（网络传输协议类型）为HTTP或HTTPS的监听有效。如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，全球加速将放弃等待，并给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The maximum version of the HTTP protocol. Valid values:
http3: HTTP/3.
http2 (default): HTTP/2.
http1.1: HTTP/1.1.
This parameter is supported only by HTTPS listeners
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP协议的最大版本，取值：
http3：HTTP/3。
http2（默认值）：HTTP/2。
http1.1：HTTP/1.1。
仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
parameters.name: http_version
